messages.content: Write an announcement telling customers that a service is moving to a new platform next quarter. Around 250 words.

We're moving to a new platform this fall

Starting in Q4, we're migrating [Service Name] to a new platform. The change touches login, billing, and parts of the dashboard. The core service runs the same way it does today.

Why now: our current infrastructure has hit its limits on speed and uptime as our user base grew. The new platform fixes both and clears room for features we delayed.

What changes for you:
- A new login flow with single sign-on support
- A faster dashboard, especially for large accounts
- One consolidated invoice instead of the current split system
- Same API endpoints; you'll need to reissue authentication tokens

What stays the same: your data, your account settings, and your existing integrations. We handle the migration on our end. You take no action until the week of your switch, when we send login instructions.

Timeline:
- **October**: Early access opens for teams who want to test the new platform first
- **November**: Migration runs in waves, by account size
- **December**: The old platform shuts down; every account runs on the new system

We email each account two weeks before its migration window with exact dates and a rollback contact in case something breaks. Questions before then go to support@[company].com, or reply to this email directly.

Thank you for sticking with us through this transition.
Rewrite the text above. Keep the same length and the same purpose. Return only the rewritten text.
